item.text: I’ve compared sustained four-lane damage, a retreat relay, and a structure that combines blocking with healing. The opening DP budget makes an immediate four-lane formation with more expensive melee units difficult. I’m examining whether an early caster can take over eastern roadblock clearance, freeing a roster slot while preserving medical support and actual blocking.
